brief.intent: RambleDesk desktop app Gate 1 direction C, Secretary Desk: a quiet document-first desktop workspace where typography, thin rules, state labels, and restrained Rambelle companionship carry the brand. Optimize for long writing sessions and low cognitive load.
brief.audience: Developers, designers, and testers who operate software while continuously recording, later editing, and delivering high-quality feedback packages to an Agent.
brief.emotionalGoal: Rambelle has already organized the archive and is waiting for the Commander to continue; professional, gentle, clear, and always explicit about whether the record is safe.
brief.composition: 1536 by 1024 landscape desktop app. Minimal custom titlebar; compact navigation and request index on the left; roughly 70 percent of the width is a paper-like translucent rich-text editor; task instructions collapse into a summary strip above; a quiet Rambelle assistant status card and primary action sit at lower right. Attachments appear primarily as inline document blocks, not as a media wall.
mustInclude: Cross-platform custom titlebar with identity, queue navigation, project, sync/connection state, settings, and window controls
Clear pending/history navigation and current request index
Maximized rich feedback flow with inline images, quotes, code/clipboard blocks, and attachment placeholders
Low-distraction Start or Continue Ramble entry with recording and save state near the document
Fast access to task instructions, context, attachments, and submit
New hexagonal vault-door emblem, line grid, transparent archive slate, cold silver-white, ice blue, cyan, and sparse amber
Clear Simplified Chinese typography for sustained reading
avoid: Too many dashboard cards or decorative data visualizations
Landing-page hero typography or oversized character art
Old circular zero emblem or eye-like symbol
Retro Print, Glitch, or dark cyberpunk
Making detached attachments the main workspace

acceptanceCriteria: Editor is the absolute visual center and comfortable for long use
All core functions remain accessible without added cognitive load
Brand identity comes from systematic detail rather than large illustration
Titlebar, navigation, editing, save, and submit hierarchy is clear
Matches latest Rambelle persona and hexagonal emblem specification
notes: RepoChan Web Designer Gate 1 visual direction C. Recommended baseline for MVP because it minimizes implementation and interaction complexity.
